limits: The frozen selection contains 93 native .blend files: 92 selected current source files and one retained precursor needed by a historical tram generator. This is not 93 distinct accepted designs.

498 suite allocation rows reuse 48 room-family prototype sources across six contracts. They are not 498 unique source files, accepted completed suites, active installed rooms or passenger capacity. Tidal remains candidate_not_default_enabled and reports installed_guest_units=0.

The initial 27 source/live-export identities are resolved by BINDING_RECONCILIATION_R002.json. The 48 suite prototype source/live-export pairs are independently rechecked against their current contracts here. Shared door and tram source identities must not be inflated into an unperformed new roundtrip.

All 27 literal tram dependency paths and the late controls dependency are present with exact expected hashes, but complete runnable historical generator closure is not established. The two frozen-batch manifests still reference 24 and 20 absent historical files, respectively; historical scripts also contain absolute old workspace paths and current-catalogue registration guards.

Native Blender opening, native version compatibility, packed/external-resource portability, full material/dependency completeness, a fresh export roundtrip and whole-main scene editor authoring are not proved by this read-only ledger.
Three historical botanical dependency conflicts remain as recorded in NATIVE_ACQUISITION_RECEIPT.json; do not replace shared current files with incompatible historical bytes.

The 58 received-section native sources are a separate parent-owned R003 archive-recovery scope and intentionally remain pending and excluded from this frozen R002 count, even if a later parallel recovery creates files.
No new engine/import job, geometry generation, runtime/visual acceptance, whole-ship completion or deployment is claimed.
